svg.text: AgentX desktop character: pose sheet, version 3
The orb, grown into a small creature. Same round body, the agent's own colours, two eyes, no mouth. It has no legs: it hovers. It reacts, it never interrupts.
breathes slowly, blinks now and then
you start talking: it stretches up and looks at you
leans in; the rings follow your voice
looks down at its work, eyes half closed
a small bounce with each sentence
a nod: eyes smile, body dips
idle for a while: settles and sleeps
hops and rings on both sides
tilts its head and waits, never interrupts
MOVING ALONG THE EDGE: IT HOVERS
turns the way it will go
No legs: it floats just above the edge and bobs slowly. Which edge it moves along is to confirm with the owner (most likely the Dock).
HOVERING OVER THE PAGE, GUIDING YOU
leans the way it is going
stops beside it and looks at it
gets out of the pointer's way
EACH AGENT KEEPS ITS OWN COLOURS
Example only, issue 458. Vector, drawn in code like the orb today; colours from src/voice/orb-palettes.ts.
